items.title: Weekly Budget Summary
items.description: When preparing my weekly budget, I want to see spending by category so I can adjust before overspending. The view should group transactions and highlight over-budget categories.
items.outcome: Reduce time spent on budget review from 30 minutes to 5 minutes
acceptance_criteria: Shows current month transactions grouped by category
Displays total spent and remaining budget per category
Tapping a category shows individual transactions
